name: Breakfast with Santa at Dave & Buster's Pineville
cost: From $27.94 per person, $33.01 with a $10 Power Card
paras: Dave & Buster's in Pineville opens early for Breakfast with Santa on Saturday, December 12, 2026, from 9 to 11 AM, at 11049 Carolina Pl Pkwy, Pineville, NC 28134. Families get VIP access before the doors open to the public, and the banquet has pancakes with toppings, scrambled eggs, breakfast potatoes, bacon, sausage and a fresh fruit platter.

Each ticket includes unlimited soda and juice, a photo with Santa, holiday crafts and letters to Santa. The Holly Jolly Breakfast ticket is $27.94, and the Santa's Ultimate Workshop ticket is $33.01 and adds a $10 Power Card with three hours of unlimited video game play. Prices include tax and gratuity, children under 2 do not need a ticket, and tickets are non-refundable.
tip: Pick the Workshop ticket if the kids want arcade time, and buy early since seats are limited.

name: Breakfast with Santa at Dave & Buster's Concord
paras: Concord Mills Boulevard is home to the Concord store's Breakfast with Santa on Saturday, December 12, 2026. The doors open to ticket holders at 9 AM for a two-hour morning that wraps up at 11 AM.

Two ticket levels are sold through Fever. The food-only Holly Jolly Breakfast is $27.94, and Santa's Ultimate Workshop is $33.01 with a $10 Power Card good for three hours of unlimited video games. Tax and gratuity are built into both prices, and every adult needs a ticket.
tip: Grab the Workshop ticket for the arcade time and keep an adult with each child.

name: Santa's Workshop at Keith Clinic
when_note: Saturday, December 5, 2026, 9 AM to noon, at the Freedom Drive and Central Avenue offices
paras: Keith Clinic hosts a Santa's Workshop morning on Saturday, December 5, 2026, from 9 AM to noon. Kids snap a picture with Santa, decorate a Christmas mug, write a letter to Santa, enjoy cookies and are entered into a raffle.
The event runs at the clinic's two Charlotte offices, 4016 Freedom Drive and 5344 Central Avenue. The listing shows no price, so check the clinic's Instagram post or call before you go.
tip: Choose the office closest to you, and bring a camera for the Santa photo.

name: Santa at Blackhawk Hardware
venue: Blackhawk Hardware, Park Road Shopping Center
when_note: Weekends from November 28 to December 20, 2026: Saturdays 10 AM to 3 PM, Sundays 11 AM to 2 PM
paras: Santa and Mrs. Claus are back at Blackhawk Hardware in the Park Road Shopping Center every weekend from November 28 through December 20, 2026. Santa is in on Saturdays from 10 AM to 3 PM and Sundays from 11 AM to 2 PM.
Kids and friendly pets can pose for photos and see the store's Christmas Wonderland. On Saturday, December 12, from 11 AM to 2 PM, kids can also drop off letters to Santa.
tip: Bring the family dog for a photo, and come on December 12 to hand Santa a letter.
